meta.description: Italian restaurant in Pointe-Claire. Pasta, pizza, grill, and fish. 950 St-Jean Blvd. Reserve on TB Dine or call (514) 694-8611.

home.title: Scarolie's
home.lead: Pasta emporium on St-Jean. A table through TB Dine, or call (514) 694-8611.
home.heroAlt: Rack of lamb with rosemary, grilled vegetables, and sauce.
home.bookTitle: A table, or a plate to go
home.bookLead: Online reservations go through TB Dine. Family takeaway plates are for four — call the restaurant.
home.svcLead: Pasta, antipasto, chicken and veal, pizza, grill, fish, baked pasta. Lunch includes soup of the day. Tax extra. Prices may change.
home.placeLead: Italian cooking, patio, free parking. Monday–Thursday 11:00–21:00, Friday–Saturday until 22:00, Sunday 11:00–21:00.
home.aboutLead: Scarolie's is known for Italian cooking and a warm room — classic recipes, house plates, and a wine list. Intimate dinners, groups, and business tables.

locations.title: Hours
locations.lead: One restaurant. 950 St-Jean Blvd., Pointe-Claire, QC H9R 5N8.
locations.note: Reserve on TB Dine or call (514) 694-8611. Email: scarolies@yahoo.ca.

appointments.title: A table
appointments.lead: Online reservations go through TB Dine, the booker on their live site. You can also call. Email is for messages — it does not take tables.
appointments.emailNote: Questions: scarolies@yahoo.ca. Tables: TB Dine or (514) 694-8611.
appointments.urgentLead: Walk-in is possible; a reservation on TB Dine or a call is the sure way.

clinic.title: About
clinic.lead: Scarolie's is known for its Italian cooking and a warm room. Traditional recipes, house specialties, desserts, and a wine list.
clinic.tech: The room suits a dinner for two, a group, or a business table. Patio, free parking, wheelchair access. Visa, Mastercard, Interac.

contact.title: Contact
contact.emailNote: scarolies@yahoo.ca is published on their site. It does not take table reservations — use TB Dine or the phone. Their VIP list lives on the live site.

services.title: Menu
services.lead: Dinner, lunch (soup of the day included), family plates for four, and $13 martinis. Wine list as a PDF. Tax extra. Prices may change without notice.
services.pdfNote: Wine prices are on their PDF, not invented here.
services.tax: Prices exclude taxes and are subject to change without notice.

walkin.title: Family plates
walkin.lead: Takeaway plates for four people — lasagna, cacciatore, salmon, tortellini, penne arrosto, bolognese, Calabrese chicken, mixed grill, pork chops, chicken parmigiano. Call (514) 694-8611. Prices may change.
walkin.hours: Pickup during opening hours. There is no separate online store on their site.
walkin.hoursConflict: Ask the restaurant which plates are available today.
walkin.familyLead: We do not take family orders by web form. Call the restaurant.
walkin.urgent: Dinner takeout is also on the main menu.
